subject: SummitPay renewal + RAG & embeddings expansion — post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Jensen <olivia.jensen@summitpay.com>, SummitPay Procurement <procurement@summitpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: today’s renewal/expansion call — RAG + embeddings use cases (pilot proposal)

Hi Olivia / SummitPay team,

Thanks again for your time earlier — appreciated the candid product context. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned and so procurement has what they need to move the renewal + pilot discussion forward.

Summary of pain points you described:
- Latency spikes during high-concurrency reconciliation reports (~150 reqs/s peaks) causing timeouts for downstream dashboards.
- Growing token spend on nightly report generation and ad-hoc investigative prompts (costs up ~40% YoY).
- Accuracy/hallucination risk on reconciliation summaries — inconsistent entity linking across time windows.

Goals you shared:
1) Reduce per-month inference spend by ~30% without increasing tail latency.
2) Introduce a RAG workflow for KYC / reconciliation assistant that uses embeddings for better factual grounding.
3) Validate Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and KV-cache benefits for long-context sessions.

New workloads we discussed:
- Nightly batch embeddings for transaction metadata (estimate: 25M tokens/month -> ~1M embeddings/month).
- Online retrieval-augmented generation for agent assistant (peak 120 qps, steady 30 qps).
- Periodic large summarization jobs (long-context, 8k-32k seq).

Proposed pilot approach (high level):
- 3-week Dedicated pilot with a small reserved GPU pool sized for 50 qps sustained + burst to 150 qps.
- Baseline and post-pilot metrics: average latency P50/P95, cost per 1k tokens, reduction in hallucination rate measured on standard prompt set.
- Deliverables: usage export, SOW draft, and dedicated-runbook for data access and KMS controls.

Immediate ask / next steps:
1) I attached your Q1 usage export we pulled from the account and a first-pass SOW (SOW_SummitPay_RAG_pilot_v1.pdf). Please review the SOW and confirm any procurement/legal constraints.
2) Can we schedule a technical scoping call with your infra lead (to confirm data residency / network requirements) — proposed slots: Tue 5/5 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 5/6 13:00-14:00 PT.
3) Procurement: if you can confirm target decision date (you mentioned early June), we’ll align discounts and pilot credits into the SOW.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (CS) to align on onboarding, and we’ll bring Monica (pricing) into the thread when we lock pricing details.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- summitpay_q1_usage_export.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)
- SOW_SummitPay_RAG_pilot_v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Olivia Jensen <olivia.jensen@summitpay.com>

Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 09:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: today’s renewal/expansion call — RAG + embeddings use cases (pilot proposal)

Thanks Karthik — that recap looks right to me. A couple quick notes from procurement and security perspective: 

- Procurement asked whether Redwood can sign an amendment for data residency (EU/US split) — we have some EU-stored customer PII.
- Security asked about SOC 2 Type II evidence and whether we can get an audit pack before pilot.
- Budget note: leadership is supportive of a pilot but wants clarity on expected burn and a hard cap during the pilot.

We’d like the technical scoping call — Tue 5/5 10:00 PT works for our infra lead (Hector Ramos). I’ll loop him in on the invite.

Olivia Jensen
Head of Platform Engineering, SummitPay
olivia.jensen@summitpay.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: today’s renewal/expansion call — RAG + embeddings use cases (pilot proposal)

Thanks Olivia — great. A few clarifying points and answers before the scoping call: 

- Data residency / EU split: Redwood Private supports customer-managed VPC deployments and can pin data at rest to EU regions; for the hosted route we offer regional tenancy and contract-level residency guarantees. I’ve attached the SOC2 summary in the shared Drive link below; for the pilot we can provide an audit pack (NDA) to SummitPay security.
- Pilot burn cap: we can set strict quota enforcement on the Dedicated pool and provide token-level cost alerts to ensure you don’t exceed an agreed monthly cap. If a spike occurs we’ll auto-fallback to a lower-capacity model variant.

Proposed immediate actions before the technical scoping call:
1) Procurement: please confirm the legal contact and preferred SOW sign flow (DocuSign v/s internal PO).
2) Security: I’ll send the SOC2 pack to your security mailbox under NDA; please confirm a point of contact to receive it.
3) Redwood: Marissa/Monica — can you review the SOW and the attached usage CSV? Recommend we consider a 1-month pilot credit (to reduce friction) plus a 15% committed discount if they convert to Dedicated within 90 days.

Proposed meeting: Tue 5/5 10:00 PT (Hector Ramos) — I’ll send the invite if that works for everyone.

Thanks — looking forward to the scoping call.

Best,
Karthik

Related links:
- SOC2 summary (shared drive): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/summitpay/soc2-summary

Subject: Internal: SummitPay — pricing & SOW next steps

Karthik / Monica,

Quick internal note following Olivia’s confirmation and our proposed pilot:

- Approve 1-month pilot credit and the 15% committed discount contingent on conversion within 90 days. This gets the prospect comfortable while preserving margin.
- SOW edits: add explicit cap enforcement language (hard quota) and an appendix listing the model variants we’ll fall back to if capacity is exceeded.
- Security: we should include the SOC2 NDA step in the SOW sign-off checklist so procurement knows the flow.

If Monica is good with the discount, I’ll fold these edits into SOW_SummitPay_RAG_pilot_v2 and send to Karthik for external circulation.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
